guide.summary: A sugar eater that does well where oxygen is scarce and poorly where oxygen is plentiful.
guide.biology: Some real bacteria live in places with little oxygen, such as mud, and get less energy from each bite of food than oxygen users do.
guide.rules: Eats sugar without using oxygen, gaining 18 energy per carbon instead of 30. Oxygen suppresses it: its suitability is multiplied by (1 minus oxygen divided by 0.40), so at oxygen 0.40 or more it cannot feed and takes stress damage. Comfortable at pH 5.5 to 7.5, warmth 0.35 to 0.70 and salinity up to 0.25. Moves 0.25 cells per second and senses food up to 2 cells away. Prey for Amoeba, Ciliate, Siltworm and others.
guide.example: Put Dusk on sediment and in open water beside sugar, and compare where it survives.
